names.zh-Hans: 努布克基金会艺术空间

summary.zh-Hans: 努布克基金会在阿克拉东莱贡设有艺术文化空间，通过展览、电影放映和艺术讲座开展工作。
summary.en: Nubuke Foundation has an arts and culture space in East Legon, Accra. Its work includes exhibitions, film screenings and art talks.

summary.zh-Hans: 巴尔梅图书馆是加纳大学的主图书馆，提供书刊及线上资源。
summary.en: Balme Library is the main library of the University of Ghana, providing books, periodicals and online resources.

summary.zh-Hans: Kelewele 将成熟大蕉切块，拌入姜和其他香料后油炸，可搭配花生。在阿克拉的街头可以见到这种小吃。
summary.en: Kelewele is made from ripe plantain pieces seasoned with ginger and other spices, then fried. It may come with peanuts and is found on Accra streets.

summary.zh-Hans: Waakye 是加纳以米和豆组成的一道饭食，也有作为外带餐售卖的形式。
summary.en: Waakye is a Ghanaian rice-and-beans dish that is also sold as a prepared takeaway meal.
